description: S2: route demand surge x1.5 (+50%) on every vehicle whose route passes road_2_4_3, the North approach into intersection_2_3 (the C3 blockage site; 186 base vehicles, 154 of them departing inside the window). Base vehicles untouched. 7200 s horizon: hour 2 is a jittered copy of hour 1 (as in hzreal_h2) so recovery is observable. Control arm: hzreal_h2 at the same seed.
